SHAIK MAFAZ BASHA

+91 79819 24381   |   mafazshaik@gmail.com   |   Bengaluru, India   |   PMP  ·  MBA — HTW Berlin

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Digital Project Manager with 4+ years of experience delivering enterprise software and digital transformation programs across IT Services, Healthcare, and Manufacturing. Proven expertise in end-to-end project delivery — planning, scheduling, resource coordination, risk management, and PMO governance — across Agile, Waterfall, and Hybrid environments. Proficient in JIRA, Monday.com, Smartsheet, and Excel (Macros, Pivot Tables). Track record coordinating cross-functional and offshore teams, managing NRE and compute forecasts, and presenting delivery status to senior stakeholders. International exposure at Meyer Werft GmbH, Germany. PMP Certified.
SKILLS

Project Planning & Scheduling  |  PMO Governance & Reporting  |  Risk & Dependency Management  |  Agile / Waterfall / Hybrid  |  Stakeholder Management  |  Cross-Functional Coordination  |  Resource & Workload Planning  |  Budget & NRE Tracking  |  JIRA  |  Smartsheet  |  MS Project  |  Excel — Macros & Pivot Tables  |  Gantt Charts & Dashboards  |  SQL  |  Azure DevOps  |  Confluence

WORK EXPERIENCE

	Digital Project Manager 	Mar 2026 – Present
ITC Limited  |  Bengaluru, India
· Manage end-to-end delivery of enterprise digital platform projects — developing project plans, timelines, milestones, and delivery schedules aligned to business and IT priorities.
· Coordinate across business, IT, and vendor teams; track and manage risks, issues, and dependencies using structured escalation and resolution frameworks.
· Maintain PMO governance — status reporting, risk registers, project documentation, and delivery audits; present weekly dashboards to senior leadership.
· Build JIRA dashboards and Excel-based Gantt charts monitoring project health, NRE forecasts, and milestone progress — reduced reporting turnaround by 35%.
· Facilitate project meetings, delivery reviews, and milestone checkpoints across cross-functional and offshore teams; manage action trackers ensuring on-schedule delivery.
· Introduced structured requirement sign-off frameworks reducing mid-sprint rework cycles and aligning delivery scope to business outcomes.
	Assistant Project Manager	Feb 2025 – Jun 2025
Meyer Werft GmbH  |  Wismar, Germany
· Supported end-to-end project coordination across engineering and cross-functional teams in an international manufacturing environment; maintained project plans, schedules, and resource trackers.
· Prepared executive dashboards, Gantt charts, weekly status reports, and action trackers — improved project visibility across 4 departments.
· Tracked milestones, coordinated stakeholder meetings, and followed up on critical actions — contributed to 15% reduction in inter-departmental coordination lag.
· Maintained process and change management documentation; supported workflow standardisation reducing manual operational activities.
	Business Analyst — Project Delivery	Jun 2023 – Oct 2024
Tata Consultancy Services  |  Hyderabad, India
· Managed project planning and scheduling across enterprise software delivery programs — coordinated business, IT, and QA teams through full SDLC.
· Led requirement workshops, maintained JIRA backlogs, and tracked delivery milestones — reduced cycle timelines by 20% through structured requirement management.
· Owned UAT end-to-end — test case design, defect triage in JIRA, release validation — achieving 30% reduction in production defects across all projects.
· Produced Power BI and Excel dashboards tracking delivery KPIs; supported data-driven project decisions presented to senior stakeholders.
· Coordinated cross-functional and offshore teams across delivery cycles; managed dependency tracking and escalation to keep programs on schedule.
	Business Analyst	Nov 2021 – Apr 2023
CitiusTech Healthcare Technology  |  India
· Coordinated delivery of 5+ concurrent Healthcare IT modules — 100% on-time across all milestones through Agile execution and JIRA-based tracking.
· Managed cross-functional coordination across product, engineering, business, and QA teams; maintained full requirement traceability and project documentation.
· Reduced requirement clarification cycles by 30%; resolved 150+ pre-production UAT defects through structured triage — improved reporting accuracy by 25%.
EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS

	MBA — Strategy, Finance & International Business	HTW Berlin  |  Germany  |  2024 – 2025
	B.Tech — Electronics & Communication Engineering	JNTUA  |  India  |  2021
	Project Management Professional (PMP)	PMI  |  Certified
LANGUAGES

English — IELTS 7.5 (Professional)     German — B1 (HTW Berlin)     Hindi & Telugu — Native
